mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, u.username, a.action, a.resource_id, a.request_id, a.trace_id, a.created_at FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log a WHERE

SELECT r.request_id, r.trace_id, r.user_id, u.username, d.name AS department_name, r.message_id, r.route, r.reason_code, r.status, r.latency_ms, r.first_token_ms, r.cache_hit, m.error_code, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM rag_request_trace r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = r.department_id LEFT JOIN chat_message m ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.request_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM rag_request_trace r WHERE
SELECT row_to_json(u)::text FROM ( SELECT id, department_id, role, status, deleted, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} ) u
SELECT row_to_json(k)::text FROM ( SELECT id, department_id, owner_user_id, status, deleted, updated_at FROM knowledge_base WHERE id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ) k

SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(a ORDER BY a.id), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM ( SELECT id, subject_type, subject_id, permission, updated_at FROM knowledge_base_acl WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ) a
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d ORDER BY d.id), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM ( SELECT id, current_version, status, deleted, updated_at FROM document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ) d
SELECT count(*) FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'COMPLETED'

SELECT d.knowledge_base_id FROM document d JOIN document_chunk c ON c.document_id = d.id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND d.current_version = #{version} AND NOT d.deleted AND d.status = 'COMPLETED' AND c.id = #{chunkId} AND c.document_version = d.current_version AND NOT c.deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log(user_id, action, resource_id, request_id, trace_id) VALUES (#{actor}, #{action}, #{resourceId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{requestId}, #{traceId})
